name: Monestir de Montserrat
frame: X east,Yup,Zsouth; native ortho EPSG25831 pixels -> WGS84 -> geographic metres relative to anchor. Generator uses recorded local coordinates only, without network/proj4.

sourceRTT.scope: The single merged source outline covers the connected monastic/basilica/school ensemble and the museum/constructed terraces below the places. Hotels954387/954390, transport188046/192902/404125 and other detached structures remain separate and are excluded. Source height56.24 is aggregated, not a uniform roof.

classes.role: Roofed western monastery, atrium ranges, principal facade and Folguera tower; current ortho and official2025plan.
Single nave, flat lateral galleries, buttresses, upper polygonal apse and three lower neoromanesque apses; technical restoration section1994 and current DSM.
Three connected school ranges, raised open court and hipped Torre del Clericat. Partial COAC roof plan/elevations, present ortho.

Built rooms/retaining facade beneath public places, documented by technical articlep65 and owner2025plan. Only exposed perimeter masonry will be modelled; the real roof/plaza remains supplied by terrain, with no invented platform.
Very narrow terrace/stair strip in aggregated source plan; local DSM approaches ground. Not extruded to the56.24m source maximum.

folgueraTower.method: Main principal-facade tower, distinct from metal belfry and Torre del Clericat; near-flat red roof sampled at763.135/763.061/763.011m. Four-arched crown openings from primary owner axonometry; their depth is visual approximation.

lowerApses.registration: Circle fitted through authoritative RTT arc vertices 41,46,52 in the recorded geographic-metre frame; slight polygonal source curvature and roof profile remain simplified.
Circle fitted through authoritative RTT arc vertices 32,36,40 in the recorded geographic-metre frame; slight polygonal source curvature and roof profile remain simplified.

facade.registration: Front wall aligned to source atrium-hole edge775.2,784.2 to791.8,840.1. Ortho roof lip is optically shifted by~1.5m; primary wall footprint takes precedence.

basilica.method: Technical1994 section/current ortho: low faceted central roof, flat lateral galleries with exposed buttresses, polygonal upper apse; low external octagonal finish, not a huge interior-derived dome. Three lower apses retain the removed third-storey proportions described by architect.

belfry.method: Old octagonal masonry campanile beside atrium, with modern industrialized18m open gothic-style crown described by ArcadiPla. Simplified eight ribs/rings, printable thickness estimate; current DSM profile peaks763.972m. Not a solid18m cone.
belfry.planEvidence: Current ortho octagonal envelope spans approximately684..714 x755..785pixels (~9.7m); DSM apex appears near702.9,772.25. Common centre701,771 is an approximate registration within~1m of these two references, not a surveyed vertical axis.18m modern open crown over the old stone octagon is from architect interview; exact ribs are simplified.

schoolCourt.method: Real raised open school court/claustre shown byCOACplan/sections/photos5–8. Lower rooms remain below; air begins above this architectural floor, not interpolated DTM under building.

oldCloister.floorMethod: Open monastic court with sourceRTThole; present terrain supplies floor. DTM under adjoining roofs is not used as a surveyed court datum.

museumFacade.method: Visible built perimeter below the real public places; top follows observed roof/plaza surface, foot follows exterior low-side terrain. No slab/flat platform fills the places.

uncertainties: The partial COAC school project is not a full current as-built plan. Main exterior roof shapes are contrasted with the2021-2023DSM and current ortho.
Interior58x15x23m dimensions are not exterior roof dimensions; no interior dome is copied into the exterior.
Facade recess spacing/depth, stepped roof joins, belfry ribs/printable thickness and hidden foundations are synthetic approximations; floor/coping levels retain measured controls.

members.role: Roofed western monastery, atrium ranges, principal facade and Folguera tower; current ortho and official2025plan.
Single nave, flat lateral galleries, buttresses, upper polygonal apse and three lower neoromanesque apses; technical restoration section1994 and current DSM.
Three connected school ranges, raised open court and hipped Torre del Clericat. Partial COAC roof plan/elevations, present ortho.

Built rooms/retaining facade beneath public places, documented by technical articlep65 and owner2025plan. Only exposed perimeter masonry will be modelled; the real roof/plaza remains supplied by terrain, with no invented platform.
Very narrow terrace/stair strip in aggregated source plan; local DSM approaches ground. Not extruded to the56.24m source maximum.

sourceProvenance.measurementConvention: Recorded 452 DSM roof points, 122 paired DSM/DTM transverse points, 505 DTM foundation queries; 167 resolved exterior toe stations. WMS 2021-2023 source, EGM08D595 ASL. Full data and query coordinates retained locally.

constructionNotes.foundation: Variable buried bases from exterior toe profiles, minimum of three nearby resolved stations minus 0.8m. Burial and interpolation estimated. No common terrain slab.
constructionNotes.substructure: Connected enclosed masonry has a continuous internal substructure, with separate roof-height storeys and a cut preserving the real raised school court. Public places and source courtyard holes are not capped.
constructionNotes.overlapReason: Sub-source-accuracy overlap of adjacent masonry storeys prevents exactly coincident Boolean side faces. Replacement envelope includes it; measured source polygons are immutable.
constructionNotes.museumComponents: Separate exposed perimeter masonry bands under real public places; two bands remain separate closed components without an invented connector or plaza slab.
constructionNotes.sourceReplacement: The entire RTT1271519 aggregate is verified against owner plan, current ortho, restoration report and member classification. No hotel/transport ID is replaced.

contactReview.reason: Integration exposed exact-boundary rays that missed lower masonry after projection/rotation. Roof geometry and measured levels are unchanged. Probes move inside their actual wall/apse; the roof lip on the school north ledge is replaced by a physical lateral-support check.
